subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps
messages:
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about FinTechCo's roadmap for scaling conversational support across your payments and reconciliation flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Current goals: ~2k inference requests/minute peak, 99th percentile latency target ~150ms for short prompts, longer batch jobs for reconciliation overnight.
- Main drivers: customer-facing chat (low latency), nightly reconciliation jobs (throughput + cost optimizations).
- Risks: data residency for logs, PCI-related redaction needs, and burst traffic during payroll cycles.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput/latency targets, batching strategies, and quantization tolerance. Connor (SE) will join to map architecture and sizing.
2) I'll share a short capacity worksheet for you to fill with typical token lengths, concurrency patterns, and offline batch sizes.

Can you confirm availability for a 45-minute sizing call? Here are a few slots:
- Wed 16 Jun, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 16 Jun, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu 17 Jun, 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, send over times that do and we’ll match. Attached is a starter workbook (FTCO_capacity_workbook_v1.xlsx) — no need to finish it before the call, but having the token/concurrency numbers helps.

Looking forward—

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: FTCO_capacity_workbook_v1.xlsx (Excel workbook, 120KB)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. We’d love to do the sizing call. Quick clarifications before we lock in a slot: 

- The ~2k RPM is our expected peak for interactive chat during US business hours; average tokens per request is about 45–60.
- For reconciliation jobs, we typically run 50k documents nightly in parallel batches; latency doesn't need to be sub-200ms for that workload but cost-per-token is a big factor.
- We also need to confirm that logs and audit trails for inference are retained in our EU region for a subset of customers.

I can do Wed 16 Jun 14:00–14:45 PT. Priya will join as well and can share some of the redaction requirements.

Alex
Head of ML Engineering, FinTechCo
alex.turner@fintechco.com | (212) 555-8891

Perfect — locking in Wed 16 Jun, 14:00–14:45 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute. Connor from our SE team will lead the technical portion and walk through the workbook with you.

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 5m: Introductions and goals
- 15m: Live walkthrough of production traffic (you + Priya) and token/concurrency assumptions
- 15m: Redwood sizing recommendations (Connor) — instance types, batching, caching, and fallback policies
- 5m: Security/compliance checklist (logs, retention, region controls)
- 5m: Next steps / mutual action plan

If there’s anything to add to the agenda please let me know. FYI attaching the workbook again in case it’s helpful.

Thanks,

- Marissa: we’ll populate the key rows in the workbook tonight (tokens/concurrency) and upload a copy to the HubSpot deal record.

See you both at 14:00 PT.

Alex
